newsitem.title: UK: WH Smith gains after Sunday press comment.
newsitem.headline: WH Smith gains after Sunday press comment.

text.p: Shares in WH Smith advanced on Monday following speculation that the company was ripe for a takeover and a press report suggesting Tesco would be an ideal bidder for the group.
The shares were indicated 8-1/2p higher at 465p by 0815 GMT after a rise of six percent on Friday.
Shares in supermarket group Tesco were 2-1/2p better at 354-1/2p.

The Sunday Telegraph newspaper commented that expectations of strong Christmas sales could have accounted for the share price rise but also noted that the Smith family was said to be selling some of its stake.
Rumours of a major bid in the retail sector were fuelled last month after the chemist group Boots Plc said it had considered making a bid for the newsagent.

But the newspaper said Tesco would be an ideal bidder, enabling it to diversify from food retailing and convert some of the WH Smith stores into Metro outlets, which are smaller supermarkets in town centres.
